name: picturereader
description: Gives text-only models the ability to 'read' images: image_scan (coarse pixel grid + hue/color/structure analysis), image_ocr (Windows or PaddleOCR text recognition) and image_sample (exact pixel texture sampling), plus the image-reading methodology skill. Everything runs locally, no vision API required.
